name: ZIGGI-6K Revitalise scales by level once and adds a quarter of the Tinker's spell power (#10819)
contract: Revitalizing Aura 524839 and Revitalise 524838 both read ${$524838m1*$<scalingbp>+$SP*.25} in Spell.dbc. Revitalise 524838 is SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL with BasePoints 154 + DieSides 1 = 155. ScalingBase(L) = 0.0267291844060354 + 0.0048541098014737*L + 0.0001859597762293*L^2 is 0.538346 at level 41 and 1.605201 at level 80, so the base heal is trunc(83.44) = 83 and trunc(248.81) = 248. Applying the curve twice gives 44 and 399. A Tinker without gear has no Nature spell power. The Drink Fel Infusion fixture 44505 adds exactly 2000 spell power to every school, so the level-80 heal must become trunc(248.81 + 0.25 * 2000) = 748. Without the spell power term it stays 248. Revitalizing Aura 524839 casts Revitalise on the wounded Tinker every 3 s, and an average normal (non-critical) heal must restore that same 248 health, then 748 with the fixture.
